name: Phoenix-Lamar Corporation
old_description: Austin, Texas-based contract manufacturer of custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses serving industrial, medical, and telecom clients.
about:
Phoenix-Lamar Corporation, founded in 1972 by Maitland Huffman in Austin, Texas, operates as a family-owned contract manufacturer of custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses. Huffman, an electronics enthusiast with multiple degrees, established the company as a family enterprise, a culture that persists with long-tenured employees and repeat customers.

The company produces custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses, offering in-house design, engineering, prototyping, injection molding, and turnkey assembly. All assemblies undergo 100% electrical testing. The homepage notes a global reach with over 200 clients and 150 satisfied clients, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Phoenix-Lamar serves industries including computer and electronics, telecommunications, medical diagnostics, biomedical, instrumentation, traffic control, environmental testing, and contract manufacturing. Its client base includes manufacturers of computers and support systems, telecommunication companies, and applied geographical groups. The about page adds health care services and software companies.

The company emphasizes quality, citing ISO 9001:2015, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and AS9100 certifications, UL approval, and a dedicated in-house trainer. It separates quality control from production to maintain objectivity, and maintains detailed inspection records for every batch. The founder's vision of technical excellence with a personal touch drives early deliveries and precision workmanship.
